summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that its majority-owned subsidiary Fort Technology Inc. completed the acquisition of a 50.1% stake in Logia USA Inc., a fuel integrity solutions provider for data centers. The transaction closed under definitive agreements, with Fort providing an unsecured US$2.0 million credit facility to Logia USA, bearing 6% interest, advanced in tranches tied to operational milestones. Nexera holds approximately 70.19% of Fort. No price per share, premium, or advisors were disclosed. The acquisition supports Fort's expansion into the U.S. data center market. Watch for milestone-based credit advances and integration progress.
